integrity: The infinite claim has a self-contained mathematical proof; finite orbit-game and pattern-search programs provide separately reproducible bounded checks. Historical priority and formal independent correctness have not been certified.
scientific_limitations: Equivalence, counts and minimum defining width are relative to the family J(n,2), n>=3, in counting-free first-order graph logic. No conclusion is proved for arbitrary graph definability, J(n,r) with r>=3, or counting/strengthened signatures. Exhaustive priority is not established; a more general pebble-extension theorem may imply the claim.
title: Sharp ground-set visibility in triangular Johnson graphs
